description: This is a test class for the BookService in a Java-based backend application. It uses JUnit and Mockito for unit testing various methods of the BookService, including finding, saving, counting, and deleting books.

classes.name: BookServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for the BookService class, verifying core functionalities and edge cases.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the BookService with mocked dependencies before each test.

methods.name: findById_throwsException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing a null ID to findById throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: canFindByNonNullId
methods.description: Verifies that a valid ID calls the correct repository method to find a book.

methods.name: save_throwsException_ifBookIsNull
methods.description: Checks that saving a null book throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: save_returnsEmpty_ifBookDoesNotHaveAuthor
methods.description: Ensures that saving a book without an author returns an empty Optional.

methods.name: canSaveIfBookHasAuthorAndPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Test (currently disabled) to check saving a valid book with author and predefined shelf.

methods.name: canCount
methods.description: Verifies that the count method calls the repository's count function.

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Verifies that findAll delegates to the repository's findAllBooks method.

methods.name: findAll_searchesWithoutFilter_ifFilterIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that a null filter results in a general findAllBooks search.

methods.name: findAll_searchesWithoutFilter_ifFilterIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that an empty filter results in a general findAllBooks search.

methods.name: findAll_filtersByTitle_ifFilterIsNotNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Verifies filtering books by title with a non-empty filter.

methods.name: delete_throwsException_ifBookIsNull
methods.description: Checks that deleting a null book throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: canDeleteAll
methods.description: Verifies that deleteAll calls the repository's deleteAll method.
